{{Quote|Surveillance just picked up a team of Esh-kha commandos uncoupling one of the prison stasis generators. Looks like they mean to steal it.|General Skylast|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Rakata machine caves''' was a cave system located in [[The Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in [[Frozencavern Canyon]], the cave system was the site of stasis generators that powered the containment systems in the rest of the Tomb, and during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Republic forces prevented the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from disabling the generators and freeing the Tomb's prisoners.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rakata machine caves appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Republic Heroic mission "The Stasis Generator."<ref name="TOR" />
